title: Vehicle
subtitle: Long-term technical metrics derived from vehicle data recorded by TeslaMate.

battery.title: Battery
battery.estimated: Estimated from suitable charging sessions – not a BMS SoH value.
battery.notEnoughForDegradation: More charging sessions are required for a meaningful trend.

range.title: Range
range.hint: Calculated from the latest recorded SoC and rated range.

charging.title: Charging efficiency
charging.hint: Ratio of energy stored in the battery to energy used while charging.

drain.title: Vampire drain
drain.hint: Median from parking periods of at least 8 hours without an overlapping charge.

history.title: Development
history.empty: No historical vehicle metrics available yet.
